docs.loose:
Non-atomic: trivia injects before every terminal, so the rule's
own sequence may split across trivia, and the entry receives
leading/trailing skip wrappers (S5).
docs.tight:
Atomic: the body builds without injection entirely — it matches
contiguously, and as an entry it receives no skip wrapper (C8).

source:
## Semantics: C8, S1, S5
grammar ConformanceAtomic version "1.0.0" edition "v2" {
  ## Whitespace between tokens.
  trivia = 1*" "
  ## Non-atomic: trivia injects before every terminal, so the rule's
  ## own sequence may split across trivia, and the entry receives
  ## leading/trailing skip wrappers (S5).
  loose = ( "a" "b" "c" ) as abc
  ## Atomic: the body builds without injection entirely — it matches
  ## contiguously, and as an entry it receives no skip wrapper (C8).
  atomic tight = ( "a" "b" "c" ) as abc

  skip = trivia

  entry loose: loose
  entry tight: tight

  test loose {
    accept "abc"
    accept "a bc"
    accept "ab c"
    accept " abc"
    accept "abc "
    capture "abc" { abc: "abc" }
    reject "abx"
  }

  test tight {
    accept "abc"
    reject "a bc"
    reject "ab c"
    reject " abc"
    reject "abc "
    reject "abx"
  }
}
